# Hi, I'm Jacob! 

![](profile_picture.jpg){fig-align="left" width=250}

I'm a physicist and engineer who builds scientific software and hardware. I have an undergraduate degree in Applied Physics from Columbia.

Most recently, I was a Research Assistant at NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, where I developed the data-processing pipeline for a space telescope. 
Before that, I spent two years in an optics lab at the University of Arizona, leading the software and hardware upgrade of a robotic telescope.

Check out my [projects](projects.qmd) to see more of my work.
